desc:
🍯 Welcome to the ultimate Caramel ASMR Escape!
Every step makes you FASTER! 💨

⌨️ Run across delicious caramel keyboard platforms!
⚡ Gain +1 Speed with every step you take!
🏁 Build up insane speed and escape through challenging stages!
🍬 Explore sweet caramel, chocolate, and candy-themed worlds!
✨ Unlock awesome trails, items, and powerful multipliers!
🏆 Collect Wins, rebirth, and become even stronger!
👑 Climb the global leaderboards and compete with your friends!
🎧 Enjoy satisfying caramel keyboard ASMR sounds as you run!

🚀 Do you have what it takes to reach the FINAL stage? 🔥

👍 Like the game to show your support!
❤️ Add it to your Favorites!
⭐ Follow the game for future updates!
